systems.system: Système d'Information Policière de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Sécurité (section 323)
systems.tiers: not stated; the budget line is to implement and deploy it

note: A budget line only: the 2026 finance law of 19 December 2025 appropriates FCFA 1,000,000,000 to activity 78016002230, to implement and deploy SIPAO, in the ordinary Treasury-financed listing (domestic). The line names the system without saying that stations enter reports or cases in it, so it is unclassified and gives no fact; the record's own note calls it a regional police data-exchange system.
